utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s on Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, that’s what I heard too — Sunday at the community center. If there’s a list of what still needs doing, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch. I’ll share any other details as soon as we have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — Sunday at the community center. Let me know what still needs doing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks — so it’s on Sunday at the community center now. I’m in, and I’ll help once you point me to the exact issue.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — Sunday at the community center works. Tell me the exact issue, and I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let me know the plan, and I’ll be ready Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’m still waiting on the exact time, but it’s set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—what still needs doing for the repair drive at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the latest details, so I can’t confirm what’s left yet. If you’ve got the list, I can help keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works better, but I’d still like to know what’s most urgently needed so we can organize it properly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — it’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday. Please spread the word, and I’ll keep an ear out for what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it, I’ll pass it along quietly. Sunday at the community center works better for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what still needs doing, and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking, Hana — the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center now. I’m still sorting the remaining tasks and will send the list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nope, not today anymore—it’s on Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, Sunday at the community center—got it. I’ll swing by then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with setup, hand tools, and keeping folks pointed to the right spot—just tell me what’s still left on the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m still taking stock of what we’re short on. I’ll send the top priorities soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—Sunday at the community center is much easier. I’ll keep it simple and work around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re starting at the community center now, since the repair drive moved there on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the community center on Sunday. Thanks, Opal; I’ve got it now, and I’ll head over there.
